meta.name: folklore-variant-evidence
meta.description: Retrieve ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and review source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Use when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence provenance without accepting patient, phenotype, family, segregation, or private case data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询基因与疾病的 ClinGen 证据,核对变异相关文献出处
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在遗传变异解读中需要核对公开证据与文献来源。
copy.tagline_en: Look up ClinGen gene-disease assertions and trace the literature behind a variant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify public evidence and sources while interpreting genetic variants.

howto.what: Claude 通过 Folklore MCP,用一个公开变异标识(GRCh38 胚系 SNV 或简单 indel)取回结构化证据、ACMG/AMP 决策支持与来源文献,并按 resolved、ambiguous 等状态分支;不接收患者数据。
howto.when: 当你需要对单个公开变异的解析结果做确定性分支处理、把已解析变异串到相关文献,或查询某个公开基因/疾病的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性时接管。

say.text: 查一下 rs80357914 的公开变异证据,结果不唯一就先停下让我选。
say.note: 结果不唯一时列出候选并停下。

say.text: 把刚返回的 canonical_key 关联到相关文献。
say.note: 返回带匹配类型的变异关联文献。

say.text: 查一下 BRCA1 的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性。
say.note: 按基因符号或 HGNC 标识查询。

howto.what_en: Claude can send one public variant identifier (GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel) to the Folklore MCP and get back structured evidence, ACMG/AMP decision support and source-linked literature, branching on the returned status.
howto.when_en: Use it when a task must branch deterministically on one public variant's resolution status, chain a resolved variant into literature, or look up ClinGen gene-disease validity for a gene or disease.

say_en.text: Look up public variant evidence for rs80357914; if ambiguous, stop and ask me.
say_en.note: Ambiguous results list candidates and stop.

say_en.text: Chain the canonical_key you just returned into related literature.
say_en.note: Returns matches with a stated match type.

say_en.text: Get ClinGen gene-disease validity for BRCA1.
say_en.note: Query by gene symbol or HGNC id.
